title: The Effect of Financial Reporting Quality on Corporate Investment Efficiency: Evidence from the Adoption of SFAS No. 123R
eligible_reason: Single common adoption date. SFAS 123R applies to all firms in the same post period (fiscal years 2006-2007 vs 2003-2005). Treatment is HeavyESO x Post, a treated-group-by-post interaction with a triple interaction (HeavyESO x Post x OverFirm) and time-varying controls.
design_notes: Eq. (1): Investment_it on HeavyESO_i x Post_t, HeavyESO x Post x OverFirm, Post x OverFirm, HeavyESO x OverFirm, OverFirm, plus time-varying controls (AQ, governance, etc.), firm FE and year FE, SEs clustered by firm. Post=1 for 2006-2007 for all firms. HeavyESO is a time-invariant above-industry-median indicator (or decile rank in col 2), i.e. an intensity/exposure design with a single date. Sample: ExecuComp industrial firms 2003-2007. Section 5.2 adds Voluntary x Post for firms that began expensing in 2002-early 2003, also with Post fixed at 2006-2007. Published in MS 65(5):2249-2266 (2019).
estimators_reported: TWFE (firm and year FE, treated-group x post triple interaction)

ineligible_specs.location: Table 3 Panel A cols (1)-(2); Tables 4-5; Table A2
ineligible_specs.reason: single adoption date (Post 2006-2007 common to all firms); triple interaction with OverFirm; time-varying controls; continuous decile-rank HeavyESO in col (2)

screener_notes: Data are Compustat, ExecuComp, CRSP (licensed). No package. Text is the SSRN/author-accessible version; no data-availability statement. Flag came only from 'difference-in-differences' wording.
